>
> > The Commission has reduced the liberalisation rate from 1% to 0.1%, limiting the amount of steel that can be imported into the EU tariff-free.
> >
> > Countries will no longer be able to use the entire volumes of unused quotas of other countries … The carry-over mechanism … has also been eliminated for categories with high import pressure and low consumption.
> >
> > The amendment … does not impact its duration - it will legally lapse on 30 June 2026.
